research_notes_other.notes_from_film_list.txt: Update on Norfolk Four case after original "The Confessions" episode. Available via PBS.
research_notes_other.research_findings: While specific production details for a "Revisited" episode weren't found, extensive information confirms the significant developments in the Norfolk Four case after the original documentary, culminating in full pardons in 2017. A "Revisited" episode would likely cover these events. FRONTLINE did feature the case again in 2013.
